secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (server-side admin operations, bypasses RLS). Find it in your Supabase project dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret API key for billing. Find it in the Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for verifying webhook events. Find it in the Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks.

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: GitHub OAuth app client ID for repo push integration. Find it in GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps.

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: GitHub OAuth app client secret. Find it in GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps.

secrets.name: FORGE_ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret key for Forge admin session authentication. Generate a random 32+ char string.

secrets.name: FORGE_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.description: Admin access key for the Forge admin panel. Set your own value.

secrets.name: FORGE_SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: 64-char hex string used for AES-GCM encryption of per-project secrets. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for AI coding models. Get it at https://console.groq.com/keys

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key for AI models. Get it at https://openrouter.ai/keys

secrets.name: GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI Studio API key for Gemini models. Get it at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

secrets.name: CEREBRAS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cerebras API key for AI models. Get it at https://cloud.cerebras.ai

secrets.name: DEEPINFRA_API_KEY
secrets.description: DeepInfra API key for AI models. Get it at https://deepinfra.com/dash
